text.p: Here are the main reports from Lithuania's newspapers on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Tragedy struck Lithuania's second city of Kaunas on Wednesday, when five 14-year-old students at a local Jesuit school drowned after their boat capsized in the city's artifical lagoon.
- Ukrainian President Leonid Kucma will arrive in Lithuania September 23 for a two-day visit.

- Former prime minister Adolfas Slezevicius, ousted in February in the wake of a banking crisis, visited the prosecutor's office to see the progress of a criminal investigation into his banking activities. The interest earned by Slezevicius on his account in the troubled Innovation Bank was double the average rate. Slezevicius withdrew his $30,000 account last December two days before Innovation was shut.

- Leaders of the Polish Election Action and the Union of Lithuanian Poles said at a news conference on Wednesday that electoral laws were preventing Polish political parties from gaining entry to parliament.
